WITH account_region AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        SUM(CASE
                WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
                WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount
                ELSE 0
            END) AS account_sum,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3
), region_totals AS (
    SELECT region, SUM(account_sum) AS region_total
    FROM account_region
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT
    ar.account_id,
    ar.region,
    ar.account_sum,
    ar.transaction_count,
    ar.account_sum * 1.0 / NULLIF(rt.region_total, 0) AS share
FROM account_region AS ar
JOIN region_totals AS rt ON rt.region = ar.region
ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A transaction type other than PRIJEM or VYDAJ contributes zero to the account sum but is included in its transaction count, as requested. A zero regional total yields a NULL share.
